name: undefined-functions-test-94ce8c58e9/undefined-functions-e.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: 'Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported'; the ballerina/lang.array list does not include forEach
Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: 'Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:'; array:forEach is absent, while xml:forEach is listed
reason: The unmarked tup.forEach callback relies on array:forEach, which is excluded from both the supported array langlib list and the method-call whitelist. This essential surrounding construct makes the whole case feature scope even though negative rejection of undefined methods and invalid calls in supported grammar is otherwise in scope.
unsupported_constructs: Tuple/array langlib forEach method invocation: tup.forEach(...)
test_design_notes: Mixed scope: undefined string/map method and union-object/function-call error markers coexist with an unmarked unsupported array:forEach invocation.
No @args, @panic, or @output assertions occur. The @error on x["k"].length() involves a potentially nil map lookup; its rejection is distinct from absence of string:length, which is supported.
